Title: Login with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Enter a valid demo username; 2. Enter its matching password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: User is redirected to the inventory/products page
Actual Result: User was redirected to the inventory page successfully

Title: Login with invalid username
Steps: 1. Enter an invalid username; 2. Enter a valid demo password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected and a clear error message is displayed
Actual Result: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

Title: Login with invalid password
Steps: 1. Enter a valid demo username; 2. Enter an incorrect password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected and a clear error message is displayed
Actual Result: Epic sadface: Username and password do not match any user in this service

Title: Submit both fields empty
Steps: 1. Leave username empty; 2. Leave password empty; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected and required-field validation is displayed

Title: Submit username without password
Steps: 1. Enter a valid demo username; 2. Leave password empty; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected and password-required validation is displayed

Title: Login with locked-out user
Steps: 1. Enter locked-out demo username; 2. Enter the documented demo password; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected and a locked-out user message is displayed

Title: Check credential case sensitivity
Steps: 1. Enter username with altered letter case; 2. Enter password with altered letter case; 3. Click Login
Expected Result: Login is rejected if credentials are case-sensitive
